rationale: A gives a clearer, more actionable strategy: start parsimonious, calibrate, and add complexity only when sensitivity analysis shows accuracy gains. That is directly usable for parameter selection. B names an adaptive/modular approach and identifies a live alternative, plus one useful caveat about team capacity, but its rationale is less developed and partly repetitive, so it offers weaker concrete guidance. Neither provides meaningful quantitative support or explicit revisit triggers. B is slightly better on comparison and uncertainty; A is better on practical decision guidance. Overall A is marginally more useful to a careful decision-maker.
